About

The developer behind the work

I’m Umer Siddiqui, a freelance Web Developer and Game Developer. I turn ideas into things people can open in a browser and actually use — no installs, no friction.

My work ranges from a Quran memorization app with recitation and word-level feedback, to a neon arcade game with touch controls, a hand-gesture particle experiment, and a salon website with online booking.

What I care about most: a site that loads fast, looks right on a phone, and makes it effortless for a visitor to become a customer.

  • ✓Responsive first — every page is built for phones as much as desktops.
  • ✓Built end to end — design, code and launch, all in one place.
  • ✓Real, live work — every project here links to the actual site or game.
